$comment: The prepopulated data directory (ADR-0001 decision 10): `bun run prepopulated` on the artefacts with these sha256s, at this SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, must give exactly this archive (`tar`) and asset (`asset`, the archive gzipped by the pinned Bun's zlib). Checked by `bun run prepopulated --check`, never by validate or CI (it needs a build); rewritten by `bun run prepopulated --record` when the build changes.
